newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia has Danish digital technology order.
newsitem.headline: Nokia has Danish digital technology order.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Monday it won an order worth "tens of millions of markka" to supply digital switching system technology to Danish telecoms operator Netcom System Denmark.
"The digital Nokia DX 200 switching system technology will enable Netcom Systems Denmark to offer its customers advanced services based on the latest digital technology," Nokia said.
Its technology will handle the international traffic of Netcom Systems Denmark, Nokia said.
Deliveries had already started and would continue "over the next few years," Nokia said. The contract was on a turnkey basis, it added.
Netcom Systems Denmark is part of Swedish telecoms group Netcom Systems, which is a subsidiary of Swedish media group AB Kinnevik.
